Usage: main backups prune [OPTIONS]

  Delete backup sets and install records beyond the newest N per harness.

  Keeps the newest N backup sets under ~/.apothem/backups/ for each selected
  harness, and the newest N install records per install root in its ledger under
  ~/.apothem/state/. A backup set that a kept record, or the latest install
  record of any install root, still references is never deleted, so rollback of
  the latest install still restores.

Options:
  --keep N               Backup sets per harness, and install records per
                         install root, to keep.  [default: 10; x>=1]
  --harness NAME         Harness adapter name, or 'all' for every registered
                         harness.  [default: all]
  --dry-run              Report what would be pruned; delete nothing.
  -q, --quiet            Suppress informational output; only errors are emitted.
  -v, --verbose          Emit additional diagnostic output.
  --format [plain|json]  Output format.  [default: plain]
  --no-color             Disable ANSI color codes in output.
  --json                 Shorthand for --format json.
  -h, --help             Show this message and exit.

  Examples:
    apothem backups prune
    apothem backups prune --keep 3 --dry-run
    apothem backups prune --harness claude-code --keep 1 --json

  A backup set that a kept install record, or the latest install record of any
  install root, still references is never removed, so rollback of the latest
  install keeps working.

  Related commands:
    rollback   Restore a harness to the state before its recorded install
    uninstall  Remove a harness configuration

  Exit codes:
    0  Pruned, or nothing to prune
    1  Unknown harness, or no harness could be pruned (unreadable ledger, or a
       backup set that could not be removed)
    2  Partial prune: at least one harness pruned before a failure
    64 Usage error: unknown option or command, or a missing or invalid value
       (including --keep below 1)
